title: Final UI for Googlebook ‘Desktop Camera’ app revealed [Gallery]
summary: The Google Play listing for “Desktop Camera” first emerged in February with placeholder screenshots. The interface is not all that different from Pixel Camera on the Pixel Tablet, with most controls on the right edge of the screen.
